label.purpose: Buttons, dates, helper text, and form labels.

shadows.name: open-menu
shadows.purpose: Separate the open navigation menu from the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-action, #365842); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: var(--color-action, #365842); color: #fff; font: 650 14px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #8a681f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; } .ds-button:not(:disabled):hover { filter: brightness(.92); }

components.name: Menu Toggle
components.html: <button class="ds-menu-toggle" aria-label="Main menu" aria-expanded="false"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h18M3 12h18M3 18h18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-menu-toggle { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-action, #365842); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-action, #365842); cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #8a681f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.description: Compact menu with a selected destination.
components.html: HomeManage childrenProfile
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 240px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #dce1d5; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: #fdfcf8; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(25 44 34 / 12%); } .ds-nav a { display: block; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); color: var(--color-action, #365842); font: 14px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--color-action, #365842); color: #fff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #8a681f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Management Panel
components.description: Cream task panel containing child rows.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #dce1d5; border-radius: 22px; background: #fdfcf8; color: #293d35; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 10px 0; font-size: 18px; } .ds-panel-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce1d5; } .ds-panel-row h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-panel-row p { margin: 0; color: #59665e; font-size: 14px; } .ds-panel-row button { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-action, #365842); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: var(--color-action, #365842); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-panel-row button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #8a681f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Nickname field used in child editing.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: #293d35; font: 600 16px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 8px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #778b79; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: #fff; color: #293d35; font: 400 16px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #8a681f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Tabs
components.description: Switches between active and archived children.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-action, #365842); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-action, #365842); font: 14px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--color-action, #365842); color: #fff; } .ds-tabs button:not(:disabled):hover { filter: brightness(.92); background: var(--color-action-soft, #e6eddc); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"]:hover { background: var(--color-action, #365842); } .ds-tabs strong { display: inline-block; min-width: 24px; margin-left: 8px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: var(--color-action-soft, #e6eddc); color: var(--color-action, #365842); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] strong { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 18%); color: #fff; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #8a681f); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Daily Stars feels calm, warm, practical, and lightly playful. Its narrow reading column, paper-toned surfaces, forest-green actions, and small star mark suggest a household record that parents can return to every day. The interface stays approachable and dependable when it presents forms, dates, and saved state.

The system is softly layered through a warm page background, lighter panels, quiet borders, and a lifted open menu. The gold accent adds a small moment of warmth without competing with actions.
keyCharacteristics: A compact phone-first column with generous space around the welcome message.
Warm paper and cream surfaces with forest-green actions.
Rounded panels and controls, with visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Use Forest Green for actionable and selected states; keep Muted Gold for focus and small accents.

dos: **Do** keep actions and selected states consistently green.
**Do** use the light surface and quiet border for task panels, with visible focus on every control.
**Do** allow long child names and form content to wrap inside the phone column.
donts: **Don't** use the gold accent as a second primary action color.
**Don't** add resting shadows to every card; use tonal layers and borders first.
**Don't** replace the system type stack or current corner language when extending the incumbent interface.
